title: daucus carota subsp. maritimus
intro: Daucus carota subsp. maritimus, commonly known as sea carrot, is a subspecies of the carrot plant that is typically found in coastal areas and thrives in saline conditions. This plant is rich in various nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of sea carrot include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of sea carrot include flavonoids, carotenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
